chain.label: PWA had not conducted a required wildlife hazard assessment
chain.trigger: PWA had not conducted a wildlife hazard assessment

chain.label: airplane collided with one or more American white pelicans over Lake Overholser
chain.trigger: the airplane's rolling, steep descent began about the time its flight track intersected the flight track of numerous primary returns...likely reflected from a flock of American white pelicans

caused_by.evidence: PWA's failure to perform such an assessment...prevented the determination of what mitigation measures, if any, could have been implemented to reduce the risk of an in-flight collision with American white pelicans

chain.label: bird strike breached the wing's integral wet-wing fuel tank/structure, exceeding certification limits
chain.trigger: the light-colored trail from the airplane's left side as it descended likely resulted from a bird strike on at least the left wing's leading edge structure, breaching the integral wet-wing fuel tank

caused_by.evidence: the accident airplane was likely not capable of continued safe flight and landing after sustaining one or more such impacts on a wing structure

chain.label: right engine ingested a pelican and stopped producing power
chain.trigger: the right engine displayed soft-body impact damage and feather fragments consistent with the engine's ingestion of an American white pelican...the right engine subsequently stopped operating

caused_by.evidence: The right engine displayed soft-body impact damage and feather fragments consistent with the engine's ingestion of an American white pelican

chain.label: airplane departed controlled flight, rolling left through the inverted position during a steep descent
chain.trigger: the simulated airplane's left roll had to continue through the inverted position

caused_by.evidence: the airplane's departure from controlled flight likely resulted from wing structure damage sustained during an in-flight collision with a flock of American white pelicans, which far exceeded the airframe's design certification limit

chain.label: airplane struck terrain nose-down and was destroyed by impact and postcrash fire
chain.trigger: the airplane descending steeply, nose down to the ground...a large fireball followed the airplane's impact

caused_by.evidence: the airplane entered a rapid descent, and the primary returns moved from the area of the intersection toward the northwest

chain.label: all five occupants killed; accident not survivable
chain.trigger: The pilot, the second pilot, and the three passengers were killed

caused_by.evidence: The accident was not survivable due to impact forces.
